# M. Fahmi Rifaldi

> Applied AI & Full-Stack Product Engineer in Bandung, Indonesia. Builds source-grounded travel AI, local-first video tooling, and full-stack community products.

Fahmi is studying D4 Teknologi Rekayasa Multimedia at Telkom University. His portfolio is bilingual in Indonesian and English. Engineering notes distinguish production behavior from prototypes, examples, and performance targets.

## Engineering projects

- [Hallo Batam AI](https://batamtes.vercel.app/): A bilingual travel assistant that filters by area and category, ranks PostgreSQL text matches, reranks place names, and exposes verified excerpts and evidence gaps. Production uses lexical retrieval and exact-query caching. Model-matched pgvector RRF and semantic-cache logic are prepared in SQL. [Retrieval notes](https://github.com/FahmiRfld-Tech/wisatabatam/blob/main/docs/RAG_V2.md)
- [ClipForge / AI Video Clipper](https://fahmi-portfolio-sand.vercel.app/clipper/): Local-first vertical video export. The [Multimodal Pipeline Inspector](https://fahmi-portfolio-sand.vercel.app/#lab-clipper) illustrates segment-ID validation, silence snapping, and EMA-based reframing with sample data.
- [Digitalisasi Cireundeu](https://kampungcireundeu.kii.lat/): Full-stack tourism portal and self-service CMS for local businesses. Fahmi led a cross-functional team of 13.
- [Batam RAG Backend](https://fahmi-portfolio-sand.vercel.app/#lab-rag): Separate Python/Django REST research prototype with FastEmbed and ChromaDB for embedding-based retrieval experiments.
- [PromptGate](https://fahmi-portfolio-sand.vercel.app/#lab-promptgate): Dependency-free Python middleware for deterministic prompt-injection screening, request-local PII masking, and syntax-only JSON auto-repair. The TypeScript sandbox runs sample cases entirely in the browser. [Repository](https://github.com/FahmiRfld-Tech/promptgate)

## Technical stack

- Applied AI and data: OpenAI, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector, FastEmbed, ChromaDB.
- Web and backend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vite, Python, Django REST.
- Multimedia: Whisper, FFmpeg, Web Audio API, browser-based video processing.

## Leadership

- Led a Telkom University dormitory community of 3,000+ residents.
- Mentored 300+ students across five computing and multimedia courses as a technical practicum assistant coordinator.
- Led 13 contributors across frontend, backend, content, and field acceptance testing for Cireundeu.
